title: "Reset wear db" produces a lot of BG duplicates
body: I run forced collector mode. I sometimes have to use the "Reset wear db" command to fix calibration data that is out of sync. "Reset wear db" fixes the calibration data but my historical readings get a lot of duplicates. The duplicates are also uploaded to nightscout. The duplicated data shows on the phone and the watch. "Refresh db" does not clean up the corrupt data. The duplicates seems like a merge between the watch and the phone since they have/had two different calibration sets. ![58358693-43357000-7e80-11e9-9d86-449044ea3bc4](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22540796/58655369-43b78600-831a-11e9-81b6-fcc6f34aa1a8.JPG)
